t2.title: Online learning as effective as traditional classroom learning
t2.prompt: A student newspaper is accepting opinion pieces. The topic is: "Is online learning as effective as traditional classroom learning?" Write your article, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The Digital Classroom: Blessing or Compromise?

The rapid shift to online learning during recent years has sparked a global debate: Can virtual education match the effectiveness of traditional classrooms?

Admittedly, online learning offers undeniable advantages. Students can access lessons anytime, review recordings, and learn at their own pace. This flexibility can be particularly beneficial for those with different learning styles.

However, traditional education provides elements that are difficult to replicate online. Face-to-face interaction with teachers allows for immediate feedback and clarification. Moreover, the social aspect of school – collaborating with peers, participating in discussions – is crucial for developing communication skills.

Furthermore, online learning requires strong self-discipline. Without the structure of a classroom, some students may struggle to stay focused and motivated.

Ultimately, neither method is universally superior. A blended approach that combines the flexibility of online learning with the engagement of in-person instruction might be the optimal solution for modern education.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!

School online? I like school. School is good. Online... I don't know. I like my friends. I like teacher. Online is... computer. I don't like computer all day. School is better, I think.

Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hi newspaper!

I think online school is okay, but I like normal school more. In school, I can see my friends and the teacher. Online, it is hard to ask questions because the teacher is not there. Also, my internet is slow sometimes, and I can't see the lesson. I like playing games on the computer, but not for school. School is better because I can play with my friends at lunch. Online is boring because I am alone. So, I like school better.

Bye!
t2.sampleB1:
Is online learning as good as real school? I don't think so. Online learning can be useful sometimes. For example, if you are sick, you can still do your work. Also, you can learn at your own speed. However, I think it is better to be in a classroom. In a classroom, you can talk to your teacher easily and ask questions. It is also easier to work with other students on projects. Online learning can be difficult because you need to be very organized and motivated. Some people might get distracted at home. In my opinion, going to school is more effective because you learn better when you are with other people and the teacher. It's easier to focus and learn.

Sincerely,
A Student
t2.sampleB2: Is Online Learning Really as Good as the Classroom? A few years ago, hardly anyone had heard of virtual lessons; today, they are part of everyday life. But does learning from behind a screen truly measure up to sitting in a classroom? In my view, both have their place. There is no denying the appeal of online learning. You can study whenever it suits you, pause and rewatch a tricky explanation, and move at your own pace. For students juggling jobs or long commutes, this flexibility is a real game-changer. Even so, the classroom offers something a webcam simply cannot. Face-to-face lessons make it easy to ask questions on the spot, bounce ideas off your classmates, and stay motivated. Online, it is all too easy to get distracted and fall behind. To make matters worse, not everyone has a quiet space or a steady connection at home. This digital divide can quietly widen the gap between students. All in all, I do not think one method beats the other outright. A blended approach — combining the freedom of online study with the buzz of a real classroom — is surely the way forward.
t2.uzSample:
Raqamli Sinf: Baraka Yoki Kompromiss?

So'nggi yillarda onlayn ta'limga tez o'tish global munozaralarni keltirib chiqardi: virtual ta'lim an'anaviy sinflarning samaradorligiga mos kelishi mumkinmi?

Tan olish kerakki, onlayn ta'lim shubhasiz afzalliklarni taklif etadi. Talabalar darslarga istalgan vaqtda kirishlari, yozuvlarni ko'rib chiqishlari va o'z sur'atlarida o'rganishlari mumkin. Bu moslashuvchanlik, ayniqsa, turli xil o'rganish uslublariga ega bo'lganlar uchun foydali bo'lishi mumkin.

Biroq, an'anaviy ta'lim onlayn tarzda takrorlash qiyin bo'lgan elementlarni taqdim etadi. O'qituvchilar bilan yuzma-yuz muloqot darhol fikr-mulohaza va tushuntirish imkonini beradi. Bundan tashqari, maktabning ijtimoiy jihati – tengdoshlar bilan hamkorlik qilish, munozaralarda ishtirok etish – kommunikatsiya ko'nikmalarini rivojlantirish uchun juda muhimdir.

Bundan tashqari, onlayn ta'lim kuchli o'z-o'zini intizomga olishni talab qiladi. Sinfning tuzilmasisiz, ba'zi talabalar diqqatni jamlash va motivatsiyani saqlash uchun kurashishlari mumkin.

Oxir oqibat, hech bir usul universal ustun emas. Onlayn ta'limning moslashuvchanligini shaxsan ta'limning jalb qilishi bilan birlashtirgan aralash yondashuv zamonaviy ta'lim uchun optimal yechim bo'lishi mumkin.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!

Maktab onlaynmi? Menga maktab yoqadi. Maktab yaxshi. Onlayn... bilmayman. Menga do'stlarim yoqadi. Menga o'qituvchi yoqadi. Onlayn bu... kompyuter. Menga kompyuter har kuni yoqmaydi. Maktab yaxshiroq, deb o'ylayman.

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom, gazeta!

Menimcha, onlayn maktab yaxshi, lekin menga oddiy maktab ko'proq yoqadi. Maktabda men do'stlarimni va o'qituvchini ko'rishim mumkin. Onlaynda savol berish qiyin, chunki o'qituvchi u yerda emas. Shuningdek, mening internetim ba'zan sekin ishlaydi va men darsni ko'ra olmayman. Menga kompyuterda o'yin o'ynash yoqadi, lekin maktab uchun emas. Maktab yaxshiroq, chunki men tushlikda do'stlarim bilan o'ynashim mumkin. Onlayn zerikarli, chunki men yolg'izman. Shunday qilib, menga maktab ko'proq yoqadi.

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Onlayn ta’lim haqiqiy maktab kabi yaxshimi? Menimcha, yo‘q. Onlayn ta’lim ba’zan foydali bo‘lishi mumkin. Masalan, agar siz kasal bo‘lsangiz ham, ishingizni qila olasiz. Shuningdek, siz o‘z tezligingizda o‘rganishingiz mumkin. Biroq, menimcha, sinf xonasida bo‘lish yaxshiroq. Sinf xonasida siz o‘qituvchingiz bilan oson gaplasha olasiz va savollar bera olasiz. Loyihalarda boshqa talabalar bilan ishlash ham osonroq. Onlayn ta’lim qiyin bo‘lishi mumkin, chunki siz juda tartibli va motivatsiyali bo‘lishingiz kerak. Ba’zi odamlar uyda chalg‘ishi mumkin. Mening fikrimcha, maktabga borish samaraliroq, chunki siz boshqa odamlar va o‘qituvchi bilan birga bo‘lganingizda yaxshiroq o‘rganasiz. Diqqatni jamlash va o‘rganish osonroq.

Hurmat bilan,
Talaba
t2.uzSampleB2:
Onlayn ta’limning an’anaviy sinf ta’limiga nisbatan samaradorligi haqidagi bahslar, ayniqsa gibrid ta’lim modellari so‘nggi paytlarda kuchayganini hisobga olsak, tobora avj olmoqda. Onlayn ta’lim ma’lum afzalliklarni taqdim etsa-da, u shaxsan ta’lim berishning to‘liq foydalarini takrorlashga yetmaydi.

Onlayn ta’lim inkor etib bo‘lmaydigan moslashuvchanlikni taklif etadi. Talabalar materiallarga o‘zlariga qulay vaqtda kirishlari, ma’ruzalarni qayta ko‘rib chiqishlari va ehtimol o‘z tezliklarida o‘rganishlari mumkin. Bu, ayniqsa, vaqt bilan bog‘liq muammolari bo‘lgan yoki o‘z-o‘zini boshqaradigan muhitda rivojlanadigan talabalar uchun foydali bo‘lishi mumkin. Biroq, yuzma-yuz muloqotning yo‘qligi muhim ijtimoiy va kommunikatsiya ko‘nikmalarining rivojlanishiga to‘sqinlik qilishi mumkin. Sinf muhitiga xos bo‘lgan o‘z-o‘zidan paydo bo‘ladigan munozaralar, hamkorlikdagi loyihalar va tezkor fikr-mulohazalarni onlayn tarzda takrorlash qiyin.

Bundan tashqari, onlayn ta’lim yuqori darajadagi o‘z-o‘zini intizomga solish va motivatsiyani talab qiladi. Uy muhitining chalg‘ituvchi omillari vaqtni boshqarishda qiynaladigan yoki tashqi tuzilmaga muhtoj bo‘lgan talabalarni osongina yo‘ldan ozdirishi mumkin. Texnologiya innovatsion o‘quv vositalarini taklif qilsa-da, u an’anaviy sinfda o‘qituvchi tomonidan taqdim etiladigan dinamik o‘zaro ta’sir va shaxsiy yo‘l-yo‘riqni to‘liq qoplay olmaydi. Ikkala usulning ham kuchli tomonlarini birlashtirgan muvozanatli yondashuv eng samarali yo‘l bo‘lishi mumkin, ammo an’anaviy ta’limni butunlay almashtirish talabalarga nisbatan yomonlik bo‘ladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirda bo‘lgan talaba

t11.title: informal message · to classmate
t11.prompt: Write a message to a classmate about the hybrid learning proposal. Share your thoughts and ask what they think.
t11.sample: Hey! What do you think about the hybrid learning idea? I'm kind of excited about it! Two days at home could mean more flexible study time. But I might miss seeing everyone every day. It would be definitely different! Do you think you could focus better at home? Let's chat about it!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Bekzod,
School is maybe online? I like school. But home is good too. What do you think?

Bye!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Bekzod,
The school said we can learn online some days. I think it is okay, but I like to see my friends. It is fun at school. What do you think about online learning? Is it good or bad?

See you later!
t11.sampleB1:

Did you hear about the hybrid learning plan? I'm not sure what I think yet. It might be good to study at home sometimes because it's quieter. However, I also like being at school with everyone. What's your opinion? Do you think it's a good idea?

Studying from home two days a week sounds great — no early bus rides, and I could finally catch up on the tricky subjects at my own pace. But I'd definitely miss hanging out with everyone at break. What's your take? Do you reckon you'd stay motivated at home? Talk soon, Dilnoza Karimova

Maktab aytdiki, biz ba'zi kunlari onlayn o'qishimiz mumkin. Menimcha, bu yaxshi, lekin men do'stlarimni ko'rishni xohlayman. Maktabda qiziqarli. Siz onlayn o'qish haqida nima deb o'ylaysiz? Yaxshimi yoki yomonmi?

Siz biron bir sezilarli foyda yoki kamchiliklarni ko'ra olasizmi?

t12.title: formal letter · to school administration giving
t12.prompt: Write a formal letter to the School Administration giving your opinion on the hybrid learning proposal. Explain your reasons clearly.
t12.sample:
Dear School Administration,

Thank you for consulting students regarding the proposed hybrid learning model. I am pleased to share my perspective.

I believe this system could offer several valuable benefits. Firstly, online learning days would allow students to work at their own pace, which can enhance understanding of complex subjects.

Additionally, reducing commute time would give students more hours for studying and extracurricular activities.

However, I would suggest ensuring that technical support is available for students who may face internet connectivity issues. Furthermore, practical subjects like science labs should remain in-person.

Overall, I support this initiative and believe it could prepare us for future learning environments.

Yours faithfully,
A Thoughtful Student
t12.sampleA1:
Hi School,


I like school. School is good. Online is ok. I like my friends at school. Three days school is good. Two days online is ok. I don't like online all the time.


Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear School,


I think the hybrid learning is okay. I like to go to school and see my friends. But online is easy. I like to stay home sometimes because it is comfortable. Three days at school is good, but two days online is also good. I hope the internet is good because sometimes it is slow.


Thank you,
A Student
t12.sampleB1:
Dear School Administration,


I am writing to give my opinion on the hybrid learning proposal. I think it is a good idea in some ways. For example, online learning can be useful for doing homework and research. Also, it might be more flexible if we have appointments or other things to do.


However, I also think that going to school is important because we can see our friends and teachers. It's easier to learn when you can ask questions in person. I think that three days at school and two days online could be a good balance.


Thank you for considering my opinion.


Sincerely,
A Student
t12.sampleB2: Dear School Administration, I am writing to share my thoughts on the proposed hybrid learning model, and I would like to thank you for giving students the chance to have their say. On the whole, I am in favour of the idea. Studying online for two days a week would let us work at our own pace and manage our time far more effectively. It would also cut down on commuting, leaving more room for homework and extracurricular activities. That said, I do have a few concerns. Not everyone has a reliable internet connection at home, so I would urge the school to put proper technical support in place. In addition, practical lessons such as science labs really ought to stay in person. All things considered, I firmly believe this system is a step in the right direction. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli Maktab Ma’muriyati,

Gibrid ta’lim modeli bo‘yicha taklif yuzasidan talabalar bilan maslahatlashganingiz uchun tashakkur. O‘z fikrimni bildirganimdan mamnunman.

Menimcha, bu tizim bir qator qimmatli afzalliklarni taqdim etishi mumkin. Birinchidan, onlayn ta’lim kunlari talabalarga o‘z tezligida ishlashga imkon beradi, bu esa murakkab mavzularni tushunishni yaxshilashi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, qatnov vaqtini qisqartirish talabalarga o‘qish va sinfdan tashqari mashg‘ulotlar uchun ko‘proq vaqt beradi.

Biroq, internetga ulanish muammolariga duch kelishi mumkin bo‘lgan talabalar uchun texnik yordam mavjudligini ta’minlashni taklif qilaman. Bundan tashqari, amaliy fanlar, masalan, ilmiy laboratoriyalar shaxsan o‘tkazilishi kerak.

Umuman olganda, men bu tashabbusni qo‘llab-quvvatlayman va bu bizni kelajakdagi ta’lim muhitiga tayyorlashi mumkin deb hisoblayman.

Sizning sadoqatli talabangiz,
O‘ylab ko‘ruvchi Talaba
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom Maktab,


Maktab menga yoqadi. Maktab yaxshi. Onlayn ham yaxshi. Maktabdagi do'stlarimni yaxshi ko'raman. Uch kun maktab yaxshi. Ikki kun onlayn ham yaxshi. Menga doim onlayn yoqmaydi.


Xayr.
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli Maktab,


Menimcha, gibrid ta'lim yaxshi. Men maktabga borishni va do'stlarimni ko'rishni yaxshi ko'raman. Lekin onlayn oson. Ba'zan uyda qolishni yaxshi ko'raman, chunki u qulay. Maktabda uch kun yaxshi, lekin onlayn ikki kun ham yaxshi. Umid qilamanki, internet yaxshi bo'ladi, chunki ba'zan u sekin ishlaydi.


Rahmat,
Bir O'quvchi
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Maktab Ma'muriyati,


Men gibrid ta'lim taklifi bo'yicha o'z fikrimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Menimcha, bu ba'zi jihatlarda yaxshi fikr. Misol uchun, onlayn ta'lim uy vazifalarini bajarish va tadqiqot o'tkazish uchun foydali bo'lishi mumkin. Shuningdek, agar bizda uchrashuvlar yoki boshqa ishlar bo'lsa, u yanada moslashuvchan bo'lishi mumkin.


Biroq, menimcha, maktabga borish ham muhim, chunki biz do'stlarimiz va o'qituvchilarimizni ko'rishimiz mumkin. Savollarni shaxsan berish imkoniyati bo'lganda o'rganish osonroq. Menimcha, maktabda uch kun va onlayn tarzda ikki kun yaxshi muvozanat bo'lishi mumkin.


Fikrimni inobatga olganingiz uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,
Bir O'quvchi
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Maktab Ma’muriyati,


Men taklif etilayotgan gibrid ta’lim modeli bo’yicha o’z fikrlarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Ta’lim muhitimizdagi ushbu muhim o’zgarish bo’yicha fikr bildirish imkoniyati uchun minnatdorman.


Mening fikrimcha, gibrid tizim bir qator potentsial afzalliklarni taklif etadi. Onlayn ta’limning moslashuvchanligi talabalarga o’z vaqtlarini samaraliroq boshqarishga va mustaqil o’qishga intilishga imkon berishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, shaxsan ishtirok etishning kamayishi sinflardagi tirbandlikni kamaytirishi va ta’lim muhitini yaxshilashi mumkin.


Biroq, potentsial kamchiliklarni ham hisobga olish muhim. Ba’zi talabalar onlayn ta’lim uchun zarur bo’lgan o’z-o’zini intizomga solishda qiynalishi mumkin va yuzma-yuz muloqotning yo’qligi ijtimoiy rivojlanishga to’sqinlik qilishi mumkin. Shuning uchun, ishonchli texnik yordam va shaxsan hamkorlik qilish imkoniyatlarini o’z ichiga olgan adekvat qo’llab-quvvatlash tizimlari mavjudligini ta’minlash muhimdir.


Umuman olganda, men yaxshi amalga oshirilgan gibrid tizim foydali bo’lishi mumkinligiga ishonaman, ammo ehtiyotkorlik bilan rejalashtirish va potentsial muammolarni hisobga olish juda muhimdir.


Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirda bo'lgan o'quvchi

tasks.p1_context: You are a student whose school is considering implementing a hybrid learning system.
tasks.p1_scenario:
Dear Students,

Our school is exploring a hybrid learning model that combines online and in-person classes. Under this system, students would attend school three days a week and study online for two days. We are seeking student feedback on this proposal before making a final decision.

The School Administration
